newsitem.title: USA: Circle's Kopshever to head auto logistics.
newsitem.headline: Circle's Kopshever to head auto logistics.

text.p: Circle International said it has promoted John Kopshever to senior vice-president of the global freight forwarder and president of its new automobile logistics division.

Circle president Steve Leonard said Kopshever will be responsible for the strategic direction, development and growth of the company's equity joint venture with automotive logistics provider Total Distribution Services.

Circle said that Kopshever also becomes executive vice-president and a member of the board at TDS. With its headquarters near Toronto, TDS is a leading provider of overseas shipping services for the automobile industry.

Kopshever, has worked for 12-years with Circle and its parent company, Harper Group and was most recently vice-president of Ocean services for Circle. -Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
